sloka: अर्थस्यैते परित्यागे दोषाः प्रव्याहृता मया।राज्यमुत्सृजता वीर येन बुद्धिस्त्वया कृता ।। ६.८३.३७ ।।
transliteration: arthasyaite parityāge doṣāḥ pravyāhṛtā mayā।rājyamutsṛjatā vīra yena buddhistvayā kṛtā ।। 6.83.37 ।।

translations.english: 'If you give up wealth the evils will follow you', said I. Now you left the kingdom. The basis on which you made such a resolve is not known to me.
